Off: downloads work as in Telegram X.
Low: files you tap download before automatic downloads. Videos you open load 20 seconds ahead (10 without boost).
Medium: as Low, and automatic downloads of videos, files and music wait for chat photos and avatars. Videos load 30 seconds ahead.
High: as Medium, and files you tap also go before music and videos that are playing. Videos load 1 minute ahead.
Max: as High, and videos you open download in full while you watch.
Changes which files download first and how far ahead videos load. It can\'t make a single file faster.
Drag an item by its handle to change the order.
The order of the actions a long press on a chat shows, in the chat preview and in the quick actions. Drag an action by its handle, or hold it, to move it. Actions a chat does not have are left out.
How long XGram keeps its copies of messages that were never deleted or edited. Deleted and edited ones are kept until you clear them.

Everything XGram adds to Telegram X
XGram brings the best of AyuGram, NagramX and exteraGram to Telegram X. Tap a row to try it.
Find this list again in the side menu → XGram.
Read without read receipts, stay offline, no typing, send as scheduled or silently. Counters still clear on your phone.
Topic list or tabs (top or side), search, pinned order, typing in rows, per-topic pins and mute, correct unread badges.
Deleted messages stay in the chat with a trash icon, media included. See every version of edited messages.
Ten XGram icons, from Midnight neon to Gold, with themed icons on Android 13+.
Bookmark any message and find it again in one list.
Your Saved Messages grouped by the chat they came from.

Chat list and chat side by side when the screen is wide enough.
IDs with estimated registration date, join date in groups, local names only you see.

The message text is sent to %1$s to be translated. Their privacy policy applies. Unofficial free service: it can be slow, limited or stop working. Plain text only. Never used in secret chats.

Incoming messages in other languages are translated as they appear, except Do not translate languages and secret chats. A chat can be turned on or off in its menu.

Choose which buttons the message box shows. A button you keep still appears only where it applies, like bot commands in chats with bots.

Without the bot commands button, typing / still lists the commands, and the button for a bot\'s keyboard still shows. Without the camera button, the camera is in the attach menu\'s gallery. Without the scheduled messages button, they open from the chat\'s ⋮ menu.\n\nThe emoji and sticker button always stays: it\'s the way to stickers, GIFs and emoji.
Tap the microphone to record and tap Send or Cancel to stop. Long press switches between voice and video.

Videos play inside the message with a seek bar, and a tap turns the sound on or off. Autoplay follows Autoplay GIFs, Data Saver and, on mobile data, automatic media download.
Shapes, motion and lists follow Material 3 Expressive. The app restarts to apply the change.
When half open like a book
Held half open like a book, the chat list and the chat meet at the fold. Standing half open, videos, calls and the camera show above the fold and their buttons below it.
Half the screen each, at the fold
Drag the handle on the line between the chat list and the chat to change their widths. XGram keeps the width you set; double-tap the handle to go back to the usual width.
Drop photos, videos, files or text from another app onto a chat, or onto a chat in the list, to send them. In the media viewer, hold a photo or video, then drag it to another app.
Auto sends with Enter on a hardware keyboard, and the on-screen keyboard follows Send with Enter. Shift+Enter adds a new line and Ctrl+Enter always sends.
